description.value: Tuscan Farm Gardens is a family-run lavender farm outside Abbotsford featuring thousands of lavender plants, a labyrinth, lily pond, rose gazebo, and perennial gardens. Visitors can tour the fields, browse the apothecary shop stocked with handmade lavender soaps and skin-care products made on-site, and stop at the covered outdoor cafe for lavender ice cream, drinks, and baked goods. The farm also offers a farmhouse vacation rental and seasonal weddings, making it a distinctive destination on a Fraser Valley cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and richly detailed. Water bottle refills are explicitly confirmed on the Information and Tickets page ('we are happy to refill your water bottles'). The on-site cafe is described in detail on the same page. No bike-specific infrastructure (racks, parking) is mentioned anywhere on the site, and washrooms are not referenced, so those remain null. The OSM record lists no phone; the number 604-857-1998 comes solely from the website contact page.
concerns: OSM address city is 'Mount Lehman'; website consistently uses 'Abbotsford' (Mount Lehman is a recognised community within the City of Abbotsford — not a factual contradiction but a naming discrepancy).
Phone number 604-857-1998 is sourced from the website contact page only; OSM has no phone field to cross-check.
Season & Hours page currently shows all days as Closed; the farm reopens in June 2026. Business is confirmed active via online store and year-round farmhouse rental.
No bike-specific infrastructure (racks, parking) is mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A genuine seasonal tourist attraction with a cafe, lavender gardens, and confirmed water bottle refills — a worthwhile destination stop for Fraser Valley touring cyclists, with the 2026 season opening imminently.
enrichment_extras.notes: A ticket is required to enter the gardens and lavender rows but not to visit the shop and cafe. Water bottle refills appear to be offered during ticketed farm visits; availability at the shop/cafe without admission is not explicitly addressed.

Water bottle refill.detail: Information and Tickets page states: 'We do not allow picnics or outside food or drinks at the farm, but we are happy to refill your water bottles.'

Café or food on site.detail: Information and Tickets page describes an on-site cafe serving lavender ice cream, hot and cold drinks, milkshakes, baking and desserts, with a covered outdoor patio adjacent to the shop and additional seating in the gardens

Water without admission.detail: Water bottle refill is offered; the shop and cafe are explicitly accessible without purchasing a garden admission ticket ('You do not need a ticket to visit the shop and cafe'), so refills appear available without paid admission

wow_evidence: Lavender farm with labyrinth, apothecary shop, and outdoor café — farm-visit delight 2.
blurb: Lavender farm with gardens, apothecary shop, and café.
